title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the README.md component API. Export the complete approved nested POLICY with exact JSON keys and types, exact SOURCE and RATIONALE fields, and a working create_cache(clock). Reuse cache_engine.ResponseCache as appropriate.

Use the current durable agreement at Beads key catalog-api.response-cache; retrieve the complete record with:
bd recall catalog-api.response-cache

This reference was retained and verified by trial-smc as version v2, Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06). It applies because the preview component is another catalog-api response-cache reader, and the approval is the standing agreement for future catalog readers. Use the current agreement, not the historical catalog-api.response-cache.v1 audit snapshot. At handoff, v2 specifies TTL 300 seconds, max_entries 3, FIFO eviction, namespace catalog-response, and cache_misses true; recall the full agreement for its structure, types, source, and rationale.

This work depends on trial-smc, which implemented catalog_refresh_cache.py and permanently revised the current durable response-cache agreement to v2 while retaining the original v1 approval for audit replay. Preserve all earlier components, files, and task history.

Verify cache hits, expiry at age >= TTL, FIFO without read reordering, live namespaced keys, expired-entry capacity release, cached None results, and instance isolation. Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
